# ⚔️ LastBreath SMP | Bedrock Hardcore

**ONE WORLD. LIMITED LIVES. PERMANENT CONSEQUENCES.**

Welcome to LastBreath SMP, a hardcore Minecraft Bedrock survival server where every decision matters!

❤️ **Hardcore Survival** — Lose your lives, and you're permanently banned!

⚔️ **Real Bedrock PvP** — No Java combat mechanics!

🏰 **Build & Conquer** — Create bases, form alliances, and fight for survival!

💀 **Permanent Bans** — Once you're eliminated, there's no coming back!

🌎 **Multiplayer Survival** — Explore, fight, and become a legend!

**Do you have what it takes to survive?**

🔥 Join LastBreath SMP and prove yourself!
